title: An extended Lagrange FEM for the Maxwell eigenvalue problem
summary: We construct an extended Lagrange FE space to solve the Maxwell equation and its eigenvalue problem in $\mathbb R^d$ $(d=2,3)$, which is the sum of the vectorial $p-$order Lagrange FE space ($p\ge1$) and the gradient of the $p+1-$order Lagrange FE space. The two lowest-order methods in 3D adopt slightly less degrees of freedom than the second family of the same order edge element methods in 3D. We construct a Clément interpolant operator to prove the discrete compactness of the FE space and the convergence of the new methods for both Maxwell equation and its eigenvalue problem. For the…
